components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill primary action; the only saturated element in the system.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:40px; padding-inline:24px; border:1.5px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; background:#3b63fb; color:#fff; font-family:'adobe-clean',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0; transition:background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.42,0,0,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#274dea; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding-inline:24px; border:1.5px solid #000; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#000; font-family:'adobe-clean',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; transition:background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.42,0,0,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:rgba(0,0,0,0.04); }

components.name: Ghost-White Button
components.description: Action over imagery / dark act; translucent white hairline with backdrop blur.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding-inline:24px; border:1.5px solid #fff; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#fff; backdrop-filter:blur(16px); font-family:'adobe-clean',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; transition:background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.42,0,0,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

components.name: Translucent Nav Pill

narrative.overview: BizPro Hub is an Adobe marketing landing page rendered with the Adobe Spectrum 2 token system and the proprietary Adobe Clean / Adobe Clean Display typefaces. Corporate-premium and product-forward, it runs a deliberate two-act structure: a bright upper half on white and warm-stone surfaces handing off to a black lower half where full-bleed imagery and white type carry the weight. Depth comes from layering, scrim gradients, and the act change — not drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Spectrum-2 token vocabulary (--s2a-*): discrete color, type, spacing, radius scales.
Adobe Clean Display 900 for every heading; Adobe Clean 400/700 for body.
Two-act light→dark page structure; white type over imagery on the dark act.
Fully pill-shaped (999px) button system in four variants.
Motion-aware: scroll-scaled hero video, parallax, carousels (Lenis smooth scroll).

rules.name: The Single-Voice Blue Rule
rules.body: Exactly one chroma: #3b63fb is the sole saturated color, on primary actions and links only — never as a section ground.

rules.name: The Two-Act Rule
rules.body: White above, black below; the handoff happens once at the Acrobat Studio banner and the lower act commits fully to white-on-black.

rules.name: The Black-Display Rule
rules.body: Every heading is Adobe Clean Display weight 900; there is no light or regular display cut in use.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and eyebrows are sentence case, never uppercased.

rules.name: The Flat-Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards and sections are flat at rest; the only resting elevation is the translucent blurred nav.

dos: Do keep Adobe Blue (#3b63fb) as the only saturated color — primary actions and links exclusively.
Do set every heading in Adobe Clean Display weight 900 with negative tracking and sub-1.0 line-height.
Do respect the two-act structure: white/warm-stone upper act, pure-black lower act with white type.
Do keep buttons fully pill-shaped (999px) across all four variants.
Do use scrim gradients (not box-shadows) for white-text-over-image legibility.
Do reserve Adobe Red (#eb1000) to the corporate wordmark.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or use blue as a section background.
Don't uppercase headings or eyebrows — the system is sentence-case.
Don't add resting drop-shadows to cards or sections; surfaces are flat.
Don't ship the AI search input without a visible focus ring (current a11y gap).
Don't substitute generic system fonts for Adobe Clean; the cuts are proprietary.
Don't swap the hero video for a static image without re-checking the scroll choreography.
